field_meaning.hi: 3D दृश्य को 2D तल पर प्रोजेक्ट करना।

review_objections: NVIDIA: Hindi definition '3D दृश्य को 2D तल पर प्रोजेक्ट करना' is generic for any 3D-to-2D projection and does not capture the perspective-specific aspects (e.g., vanishing points, foreshortening).
Meta: Perspective projection is a model, but the term is more commonly used as a technique or method
